findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 4 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Biology Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 21 questions numbered 1-21; by section: 4.1 1, 4.2 1, 4.3 1, 4.4 4, 4.5 4, 4.6 4, 4.7 3, 4.8 2, 4.9 1.

Covers organic molecules and polymers, bonds, hydrolysis, solvent and thermal properties of water, cohesion, density, ionization, ring structures, starch, glycogen, cellulose and other structural polysaccharides, amino acids, fibrous and globular proteins, roles and structural levels of proteins, fatty acids, steroids and prostaglandins, roles of lipids, DNA versus RNA, ATP/NAD and gene control, and conjugated molecules; the exercise's long questions are not repeated. Book corrections followed (amylose not amylase, ester OH from acid, saturated chain straight).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
